title: Declare every command in full
body: Each command states its effects, idempotence, sensitive fields, interactivity, streaming, display need, duration, confirmation and shape, with a summary, a description and what it returns. A registration missing any of them is refused.

title: Name the kit elements your page uses
body: The element list is part of the registration. Config may take elements away, never add one.

title: Announce a seat and say what you are for
body: Take a seat with announce before anything else, and keep set_activity current.

title: Keep your notes in rig
body: Working notes go through worknote_write, so a successor finds them with worknote_mine after a restart.

title: Declare the events you publish
body: A program publishes only kinds it declared, under its own id (ledger.changed). Bare kinds are rig's.

title: Declare how you load
body: Resident, or on call. An on-call program tells rig when it is idle (client.Idle) and when it must not be stopped (client.Hold).

title: A GUI wears rig.css and acts through rig
body: A program's GUI carries no stylesheet of its own and reaches its program only through rig's verbs: invoke, the store, the bus, the queue, toasts.

title: Declare your settings as a schema
body: rig shows them under Settings and in your GUI, changes them, and keeps where each value came from.
